# OperationApiKey

## Properties

Name | Type | Description | Notes
------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**Id** | **string** | Unique identifier of the operation API key. Generated by Tsuga when the key is created. Use this as the stable key identifier when correlating API calls with audit logs or key-management records. | 
**Name** | **string** | Display name of the operation API key. Set by the user who created or last updated the key. Returned for every operation-key-authenticated request so clients can show which saved key is active. | 
**Owner** | **string** | Identifier of the team that owns the operation API key. Set when the key is created or updated. Combined with &#x60;scope&#x60;, it determines which team-owned resources the key can reach. | 
**Tags** | Pointer to [**[]Tag**](Tag.md) | Key/value tags applied to the resource. Use them to organize resources and to satisfy tag policies. | [optional] 
**Scope** | **string** | Team-access boundary for the operation API key. Set when the key is created or updated. &#x60;all&#x60; can reach all teams, &#x60;owning-team-and-public&#x60; can reach the owning team and public teams, and &#x60;owning-team-only&#x60; can reach only the owning team. | 
**Permissions** | [**CreateOperationApiKeyRequestPermissions**](CreateOperationApiKeyRequestPermissions.md) |  | 
**KeyLastCharacters** | **string** | Last characters of the operation API key secret. Set by Tsuga from the generated secret and returned because the full secret is only shown once at creation. Use this to distinguish saved keys without exposing the secret. | 
**ExpiresAt** | Pointer to **string** | Timestamp after which the operation API key stops authenticating. Set when the key is created or updated. Returned only for keys that have an expiration date. | [optional]
